name: Rhidian Orr
tagline: Top rated DUI-DWI attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: Rhidian Orr is the owner of the Orr Law Firm in Denver, Colorado. While his primary focus is DUI defense, he also represents clients in personal injury and car accident cases throughout the Greater Denver area. Driven by a genuine dedication to those he serves, he works tirelessly to defend his clients' rights and secure fair outcomes. He provides straightforward, dependable guidance to help people navigate complex legal challenges with confidence.

Bringing a meticulous, client-centered approach to DUI defense and personal injury cases, Mr. Orr thoroughly scrutinizes every detail, from field sobriety tests and breathalyzer accuracy to accident dynamics, to uncover weaknesses in the opposing case. Whether defending against criminal charges or seeking fair compensation after a car crash, he focuses on clear communication, strategic negotiation and undying dedication to protecting his clients' rights.

Licensed in Colorado since 2002, Mr. Orr earned his Juris Doctor and MBA from the University of Denver after completing his bachelor's degree in 1994. A graduate of Gerry Spence’s Trial Lawyers College, he dedicated his career to DUI and criminal traffic defense. He is trained as both a practitioner and instructor in the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration’s standardized field sobriety tests and is qualified in Intoxilyzer 9000 operation. He is also a certified expert in drug recognition and is extensively trained in gas chromatography.

Recognized with an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, Mr. Orr is a lifetime member of both the Colorado Criminal Defense Bar and the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and formerly served as a board member of the DUI Defense Lawyers Association. Despite his extensive credentials, he maintains a deeply personalized approach to every case. He takes the time to understand each client's unique circumstances, tailoring strategic legal solutions to ensure every individual receives focused, dedicated representation.
honors: For the 8th year in a row, The Orr Law Firm LLC was the recipient of a Gold Star Award in recognition of 8 consecutive years of no BBB complaints. , Gold Star Award , Better Business Bureau , 2012

This award symbolizes his passion and concern for his clients.
